system.flavor:
Keep your sight through a flash of light, walk through a cloud of pepper or smoke, hear through a deafening bell, shake off a blow to the head, or keep walking with a leg caught in briars.

Not enough to shrug off something that holds you fast, like a locked door or a pit.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would impose an ordinary sensory or Movement-limiting Condition on you. Response (unopposed): Suppress that Condition until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Detect the source's space if it is within 3 units and not behind a solid barrier.
Also reduce Damage from the Action by 1; your current Adaptation ends.
